# Fixture sources and provenance

- `toronto-accessible-stalls.page.json`: real City of Toronto CKAN datastore_search three-row excerpt, retrieved 2026-11-15; Open Government Licence – Toronto. Attribution: Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence – Toronto. Dataset: https://open.toronto.ca/dataset/off-street-parking-surface-lots-accessible-stalls/ . The sample retains published `SOURCE` labels; it does not certify individual stalls.
- `demo-mississauga-parking.esrijson`: **demonstration data, not real places**, field names from City of Mississauga owned parking facilities; retrieved source field descriptions 2026-11-15; City of Mississauga Open Data Terms of Use (verify). Attribution: City of Mississauga, review required.
- `demo-london-parking.esrijson`: **demonstration data**, field names from City of London parking inventory; source checked 2026-11-15; City of London Open Data licence (verify). Attribution: City of London, review required.
- `demo-waterloo-parking.esrijson`: **demonstration data**, field names from City of Waterloo ParkingLots; source checked 2026-11-15; City of Waterloo Open Data licence (verify). Attribution: City of Waterloo, review required.
- `demo-ottawa-parks-parking.esrijson`: **demonstration data**, field names from City of Ottawa Parks Inventory parking layer 14; source checked 2026-11-15; City of Ottawa Open Data Licence v2.0 (verify). Attribution: City of Ottawa, review required.

All `demo-*` files use fictitious lot names and coordinates. They are tests, not real accessible parking claims.
